decision.reason: [ev-437e36865221] says only that waypoint proxies now support `Telemetry` customization. It does not say whether existing Telemetry resources start applying to waypoints, or how waypoint/ambient deployments can be identified. The proposed condition `gvk-in-use` Telemetry flags every Telemetry user, including sidecar-only environments with no waypoint. That is likely too broad, but the evidence does not support a narrower condition either. We need the waypoint Telemetry targeting semantics and a way to detect waypoints in configuration before the condition can be confirmed or corrected.
